items.name: content-types
items.title: Content Types
items.description: The prop shapes the JHAI section components take. Types only, no data. In jhai-new-website these live in src/lib/v2/home.ts beside the site's content; here the types travel with the components and the data stays in whatever project renders them.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: shell
items.title: Section Shell
items.description: Container, Section, Grain and the one stylesheet the page's marquees and responsive collapses read from. Every section item depends on this: it owns the 1280 container, the three grounds, the marquee keyframes and the reduced-motion stop that Tailwind cannot express.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: Grain reads its texture from --ui-grain, which this file does not define because the SVG is a project asset. Set it beside your palette: :root { --ui-grain: url('/assets/grain.svg'); }. Unset, Grain renders nothing.

items.name: ticker
items.title: Ticker
items.description: The outlined capability marquee. Type as texture: stroked, not filled, so it reads as a rule between sections rather than another headline.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: Logo Wall
items.description: The client logo strip. Pair with svgl.app for the marks themselves — see docs/CURATION.md, logo wall.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: faq-item
items.title: FAQ Item
items.description: One disclosure row with a plus that rotates. The unit the Questions section composes.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: questions
items.title: Questions
items.description: The FAQ section: eyebrow, heading, lede and a column of disclosure rows.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: The us-versus-them table. One highlighted column, check and cross marks, hairline rows.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.description: The comparison section wrapping the table with its eyebrow and side note.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: problem
items.title: Problem
items.description: The display-scale problem statement: a three-part heading with an italic middle, a lede and a bullet list.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: answer
items.title: Answer
items.description: The feature-scale answer to the problem: split heading, lede with an italic clause, image and pillars.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CTA Band
items.description: The dark close. Statement left, capture slot right. The slot is a render prop, not an import, because a capture form belongs to the project's funnel.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: Differs from the jhai-new-website original, where the right slot renders GraderField, JHAI's audit-email capture. That form is a funnel, not reusable UI, so it stays project code. Pass your own component as `field`, pass `link` for a click ask instead, or pass neither for the statement-only shape.

items.name: cta-band-section
items.title: CTA Band Section
items.description: The mid-page CTA band, wrapped in its section and container so it reads as a stop rather than a section.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: record-band
items.title: Record Band
items.description: A row of stat tiles on either ground. Pair the numerals with @magicui/number-ticker for a count-up.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: case-card
items.title: Case Card
items.description: The case-study card: grayscale plate, badge, title and result line.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: blog-card
items.title: Blog Card
items.description: The writing card: grayscale plate, kicker, title and date.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: tool-card
items.title: Tool Card
items.description: The tool card: title, body and an arrow that slides on hover.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: The page header: brand, nav, one optional ask. Mobile disclosure is a native <details>, so it works with no runtime. Variants: simple, centered.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: Not @jhai/section-header, which is a heading block inside a band. This is the page's own header. The mobile menu is a <details> because the registry ships no runtime and a server component cannot hydrate one; the native element brings keyboard handling and the open/closed announcement with it.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: The social proof band. One to six quotes, each with an optional real rating drawn by RatingMark. Variants: grid, single.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: `rating` is optional and is never defaulted. A default of 5 would invent a five-star review every time a caller omitted the field. Omit it and no mark is drawn.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: Brand, standfirst, two to four link columns, legal line. Variants: columns, minimal.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: Deliberately not a Section: a footer sits outside the band rhythm and takes its own padding. `minimal` is a real variant rather than `columns: []`, so an empty grid is never the way to ask for the short shape.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Eyebrow, headline, subhead, actions and optional media. Media accepts a placeholder state and renders a correctly proportioned empty plate rather than requiring a live src. Variants: centered, split.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: `media.src` is optional on purpose. A section that hard-requires a URL cannot be placed in a wireframe, and the consumer then forks the layout locally to show an empty plate. The first entry in `actions` renders primary and the rest ghost; that is a rendering rule, not content.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plan cards carrying price, billing note and per-plan CTA, optionally over a feature comparison. Variants: cards, cards-with-comparison.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
items.docs: `price` is a string and is never computed: "$95/mo", "From $1,200", "Free" and "Let's talk" are all legitimate. The highlighted card opens a nested .dark scope rather than painting a literal, which is the fix for the bug that made ComparisonTable's highlighted column invisible.
